summary: Authored exactly the nine assigned Skills B identities as immutable, employer-neutral, deterministic 2.5D geometry definitions. Each definition uses the frozen projection, orientation zero, the exact canonical palette-slot array, a complete tier-0 exterior, and line-only interior detail at tiers 1 and 2. Literal primary-path and canonical master hashes were recomputed through the existing serializer. File-local lint, strict TypeScript, schema/hash/vector audits, exact assignment closure, forbidden-reference checks, and an in-memory renderer smoke test pass. No registry, placement, scene, integration, promotion, aggregate build, or aggregate test claim is made.

controlled_source_successor.scope: branch-local G5 successor over the accepted F0 controlled set; not a merged downstream aggregate
controlled_source_successor.record_format: path + NUL + decimal byte count + NUL + lowercase SHA-256 + LF

shared_contract.instance_reuse_model: one canonical definition per skill; downstream employer instances may supply only palette and placement
shared_contract.tier_0_policy: complete exterior silhouette, primary masses, required connections, footprint-defining faces, and roofline
shared_contract.higher_tier_policy: interior linework only; no footprint, primary mass, connection, roofline, orientation, or primary-path changes
shared_contract.primary_path_policy: one normalized four-decimal closed M/L/Z code-vector outer hull containing every tier-0 vertex and curve control point with two pixels of axis-aligned envelope padding
shared_contract.easter_egg_rule: No easter egg in the canonical sheet. Any later approved decoration remains outside this lane and must be a single optional LOD-2 attachment that cannot alter footprint, silhouette, evidence, or interaction.
shared_contract.source_specific_note: The Docker gantry hook is a restrained interior line taken from the promoted canonical panel; it is not a newly invented easter egg.

The controlled-source successor is branch-local to the accepted F0 set plus skills-b.ts. It is not the eventual merged multi-lane aggregate.
